description: Defines a class 'GrainCountStatistics' that provides statistics on activation counts for grain types within the Orleans runtime, including a method to retrieve simple statistics as key-value pairs.

classes.name: GrainCountStatistics
classes.description: Provides centralized statistics on per-grain-type activation counts in Orleans.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of key-value pairs representing grain type names and their activation counts, filtered to include only counts greater than zero.
